source.changes: SRD 5.2.1 pp. 220–223 adapted into twelve versioned magic-item families (Energy Bow through Gem of Brightness) with explicit variant identities, structured requirements and typed source values. Names, numeric rules and key phrases are adapted into keys; no rules prose is reproduced. Prices are not listed and remain unspecified. Catalogue data grants no inventory, action or gameplay permissions; every record is unavailable.
